findings.message: 5 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Objetos impresos en 3D" above "Objetos que dan ganas. Impresos uno por "; "Catálogo" above "Lo que está saliendo de la impresora."; "Materiales" above "Tres plásticos. Ninguno de relleno."; "Cómo comprar" above "Elegís. Confirmamos. Llega a tu casa."; "Preguntas" above "Lo que suelen preguntarme."
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: 15 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Objetos impresos en 3D", "Catálogo", "Materiales", "El más lindo").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 1 gradient fill(s): div.process.is-visible → linear-gradient(160deg, rgb(13, 32, 64) 0%, rgb(8, 20, 40) 100%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 3 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: a.btn.btn--primary → rgba(255, 106, 61, 0.4) 0px 10px 30px -10px | div.form-card.is-visible → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 1px 2px 0px | button.btn.btn--primary → rgba(255, 106, 61, 0.4) 0px 10px 30px -10px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 14 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div.materials 1440px | section#materiales.section.section--tint 1440px | div.step 313px | div.step 313px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.
One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.
Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.
Use the accent from the drawn palette.

findings.message: Only 2 picture(s) on the page (2 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 58px (4vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.

findings.message: 2 text block(s) sit within 16px of the screen edge: "TPU flexible" (0px from the left); "Más de 20 colores" (0px from the right)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–32px or more). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Objetos que dan ganas. Impresos uno por uno." → 3 lines (8 words, 40px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.
